chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ibn Miskān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥīm ibn Rūḥ al-Qaṣīr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
Concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
The Prophet is closer to the believers than their own selves, and his wives are their mothers; and those related by blood are closer to one another in the Book of Allah.

I said, 'Regarding whom was it revealed?' So he said: 'It was revealed concerning authority. Indeed, this verse continued among the sons of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام after him. Thus we are more entitled to the authority and to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله than the believers, the Muhājirūn, and the Anṣār.'

I said, 'Then do the sons of Jaʿfar have a share in it?' He said: 'No.' I said, 'Then do the sons of al-ʿAbbās have a share in it?' He said: 'No.' Then I enumerated to him the clans of Banī ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, and for all of that he kept saying: 'No.' He said: 'And I forgot the sons of al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, so I came to him after that and said to him, "Do the sons of al-Ḥasan عليه السلام have a share in it?" He said: "No, by Allah, O ʿAbd al-Raḥīm, no Muḥammadī has any share in it other than us."'

key_terms.أَوْلَى: more entitled, closer in right and precedence
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: the Helpers of Medina who supported the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْمُهَاجِرِينَ: the Emigrants from Mecca among the early Muslims
key_terms.نَصِيبٌ: a share or allotted portion in this authority
key_terms.وُلْدِ الْحُسَيْنِ: the descendants of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: According to this hadith, whom does Qur'an 33:6 indicate as having rightful authority after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith interprets the verse as referring to divinely designated authority and applies it specifically to the line of the descendants of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام after him. It emphasizes that this right of authority does not extend to the other branches of Banī Hāshim, but is restricted to the specified Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
